note: Hand-triaged for the 1.8.0 release gate (Free+Pro paired run). Each suppression was individually verified; nothing was bulk-baselined. False positives are scanner limits (dynamic hook/key resolution); graceful-gap items read with sane defaults and are tracked as 'add admin field' enhancements, not runtime breaks.

suppressions.reason: False positive. 'mvs_media_upload' is a BuddyPress ACTIVITY TYPE string (bp_activity_set_action / activity 'type' + 'action' args in ActivitySyncIntegration), not an admin-ajax action. There is no JS posting it as an AJAX action; no wp_ajax_ handler is required.

False positive. Fired via Action Scheduler using the class constant StorageCleanupService::CLEANUP_HOOK (as_enqueue_async_action(self::CLEANUP_HOOK,...)). Static scan only resolves the literal at the add_action site, not the constant at the enqueue site.

False positive. Fired via Action Scheduler / wp_schedule_single_event using StreakService::AS_DAILY_HOOK (as_schedule_cron_action / as_enqueue_async_action with the constant). Scanner cannot resolve self::AS_DAILY_HOOK to the literal.

False positive. Fired via Action Scheduler recurring action using AutopilotService::AS_HOOK (as_schedule_recurring_action(...self::AS_HOOK...)). Scanner cannot resolve the constant at the schedule site.

False positive. Scheduled via as_schedule_single_action using TranscodeService::AS_HOOK and bound in Plugin.php with add_action(TranscodeService::AS_HOOK, ...). Scanner cannot resolve the constant to the literal.
False positive. Scheduled via Action Scheduler using TranscriptionService::AS_HOOK and bound in Plugin.php with add_action(TranscriptionService::AS_HOOK, ...). Scanner cannot resolve the constant.
